title: Junior Estimating Engineer (machining)
description:
MTrec’s new career opportunity

Our client are specialists in their market sector; they are now looking to recruit a Junior Estimating Engineer (machining) on a permanent basis.

If you are a Machinist and looking to transition into an Estimating position, this role could be ideal for you.

The Job you’ll do

  • The successful applicant will report directly to the Managing Director whilst supporting a busy production team.
  • The role involves assisting with the preparations of engineering projects, under the supervision of senior estimators while learning the estimating process.
  • Calculate job costs using company ERP system, EFACS.
  • Assisting with the preparation of tenders, quotations and cost estimates.
  • Utilise sketches and drawings to determine task times in a conventional machine shop.
  • Requesting, reviewing and following up supplier quotations where required.
  • Helping ensure quotations are completed within agreed timescales.
  • Maintain records of calculations in a database.
  • Utilise same database to improve efficiency.

About You

  • Fully committed to Quality, Cost and Delivery.
  • An accurate and flexible approach to all matters.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Good Communication and organisational skills.
  • Proficient in Excel and Word with good experience of ERP systems.
  • Ability to work within a small but multi-disciplined team.
  • An interest in engineering and manufacturing .
  • Good numerical ability and attention to detail..
  • Willingness to learn

The Rewards and the Benefits

  • Salary negotiable dependent on experience.
  • 37 Hours per week: 07:30 – 16:00 Monday to Friday, 07:30 – 12:30 Friday.
  • 25 days per year, plus bank holidays.
  • Cycle to Work Scheme.
  • Radius Allowance payable based on commute to work miles.
  • Death in Service Insurance.
  • Income Protection Insurance.
